node.title: XR prize arbitrary-W rank-two received-pair router
node.statement: For an arbitrary-W rank-two dual plane, pairing each row with its selected-error equation gives an interaction vector annihilating the Segre coefficient columns. Five-block planes and the zero-interaction four-block branch annihilate both received directions. Every nonzero four-block interaction is a scalar multiple of the Mobius hyperplane and gives an invertible pairing with the received direction plane. These are the only trade-row interaction classes; aggregate counting remains open.
